sections.text: A winter storm has isolated the mountain observatory. Tonight's comet will reveal the safe route down, if you can reach the telescope.

consequence.text: Ice gives way beneath your boots.

sections.text: The outer stair ends beneath a frozen dome. A side door leads into the keeper's quarters.

options.description: Break through the frozen dome hatch

sections.text: The keeper has left hot broth on a low stove and a diagram of the telescope controls.

options.description: Rest, then use the inside passage

consequence.text: The broth warms you and steadies your hands.

sections.text: The telescope must be aligned by hand. A signal lamp can instead guide the valley team toward you.

consequence.text: The cold metal tears your gloves.

sections.text: The comet reveals a sheltered descent. You could follow it now or attempt to retrieve one last chart from the damaged dome.

consequence.text: A falling beam clips your back.

sections.text: The valley team finds the observatory light and reaches you with warm blankets and climbing ropes.
You lead the keepers down the comet-lit route. By morning, every window in the valley is glowing.
